title: Solo 05 of assets/solo/beautiful (E harmonic minor, original), rendered at 120 bpm so one bar = one 2 s scene (`python compose.py --video-take OUT.wav`). listen = bar 1, the Em arpeggio (8 notes; a level-9 melody has at most 10); tour = bar 2, the same shape on C. The band plays through both scenes without a cut; the answer is taps on the same 8th grid; the reward after it is bars 3–4 of the take (the falling run, B4 D#5 D#5, the held E5).
